author: Yffe
content: Plan: align crate versions to v0.0.1 (the release tag). Centralize into [workspace.package] version=0.0.1 + each member inherits version.workspace=true (single source of truth, like edition). Path-deps carry no version pin so resolution is unaffected. cargo build --workspace green (all 6 crates compile as v0.0.1).
